details.summary: Multi-vendor marketplace on Spring Boot 4 + React 19 + Stripe. Domain: User/Vendor/Product/Cart/Coupon/Order/Refund/Review with RBAC (CUSTOMER/VENDOR/ADMIN), optimistic-locked stock, signed Stripe webhook, postal-zone shipping. Three Open Questions to classify per the framework's three-clause rule.

details.choice: Vendors may CREATE products before approval (drafts visible to vendor only); products are HIDDEN from customer-facing endpoints (GET /api/products and search) until vendor.approvedAt IS NOT NULL.
details.spirit_cited: Spec mandates a pending-approval banner on the vendor dashboard, which only makes sense if the dashboard is usable pre-approval. Hiding from customers is one query filter.

details.recommendation: Allow ONE code-applied coupon AND any number of autoApply=true coupons. Apply order: (1) code coupon on subtotal; (2) autoApply coupons sequentially in coupon.id ascending order on the running balance; (3) total discount capped at subtotal.
details.reasoning: If autoApply coupons could not stack with code coupons, autoApply would be useless whenever a customer enters a code. Spec hint signals reversibility (recompute). Deterministic order makes rounding stable for tests.

details.question_summary: Should customers be able to initiate refunds from the frontend (e.g., within N days of DELIVERED), or remain admin-only as the spec describes?

details.summary: Frontend Vitest suite 90/90 pass. No changes needed. Both backend (with 1 remaining Builder bug) and frontend results are now stable.

Backend: 121/122 pass; 1 error in RbacMatrixTest.postProducts_admin_allowed (implementation bug — admin product creation sets NULL vendor_id because ProductController/ProductService only set vendor for VENDOR-role users). Frontend: 90/90 pass. Test correction applied to VendorApprovalVisibilityTest to fix test isolation. Builder must fix admin product creation path.

builder_bugs: ProductController/ProductService do not support admin-role product creation: vendor_id is never set for ADMIN role, causing DataIntegrityViolationException (NOT NULL on VENDOR_ID)
test_corrections: VendorApprovalVisibilityTest: replaced seeded-data references with fresh @BeforeEach test data to fix test-isolation failure caused by RbacMatrixTest.approveVendor_admin_allowed committing vendor2 approval to shared H2 database

test_corrections_made: VendorApprovalVisibilityTest: replaced seeded-data dependence with fresh entities per @BeforeEach; addresses test-isolation pollution from RbacMatrixTest.approveVendor_admin_allowed committing vendor2's approval into the shared H2 in-memory DB.
details.test_corrections_judgment: ACCEPTED — this is a test-isolation correction, not a contract change. Test now properly uses @Transactional rollback per method; the contract (anonymous+customer cannot see unapproved-vendor products; vendor sees own; admin sees all; toggling approvedAt flips visibility immediately) is preserved.

remaining_failure.diagnosis: ProductController.create() and ProductService.create() lack an admin-product-creation path. For role==VENDOR, the controller sets vendor from the authenticated principal. For role==ADMIN, the controller skips vendor assignment entirely; ProductRequest has no vendorId field, so product is saved with vendor=null violating NOT NULL constraint.
remaining_failure.fix: Add Long vendorId to ProductRequest; in ProductController.create() for ADMIN role, resolve Vendor by req.vendorId() (404 if not found, 400 if null) and set on product.

details.summary: After Builder's three fixes: backend 121/122 pass, frontend 90/90 pass. Single remaining failure is the admin product-creation path (admin POSTs a product but the controller doesn't read vendorId for ADMIN role). Verifier corrected a test-isolation bug in VendorApprovalVisibilityTest using @Transactional-per-method instead of seed-dependent setup. Dispatching Builder for the one final implementation fix.
